_doc: Microsoft 365 Apps, installed with Microsoft's Office Deployment Tool (ODT) and a configuration.xml
that DayZero generates from this file. You activate Office by signing in with your own Microsoft account.
plans:     product ids for the plan chosen in the builder (Microsoft's list: 'Product IDs supported by
the Office Deployment Tool for Click-to-Run'). personal = Microsoft 365 Personal/Family,
apps:      what gets installed. Every other id in allApps is excluded (ExcludeApp).
allApps:   the ExcludeApp ids the ODT documents. OutlookForWindows = the new Outlook app.
odt:       where setup.exe comes from, in order: the stick's bundled\odt\setup.exe (added by the
builder), then winget (Microsoft.OfficeDeploymentTool), then Microsoft's Office CDN.
A downloaded setup.exe must carry a valid Microsoft signature or it is not run.
